text:
Mia (CS): Quick weekly check for VelaRetail — focusing on caching + batching effectiveness. Snapshot below, plus a couple asks:

```
cache_hit_rate: 42.1% (↑ from 33.4% last week)
median_batch_size: 3.2
p90_batch_size: 6
avg_latency_per_token: 11ms
cost_per_1k_tokens: $0.87 -> $0.62 (after batching + quant)
```

Observations: hit rate lift from TTL bump + prefix caching. Median batch stable; p90 driven by a small set of high-throughput routes. Questions: can infra safely raise max_batch_size for the chat route to 6? Ops: any latency regressions to call out? Also, @Leah — want a 15m enablement runbook before Wed roll-out.

David (SE): Nice numbers. Did we change prompt de-dup logic? The hit rate feels higher on support tickets route.

Ryan (Infra): We did a TTL tweak + prefix hashing change last Tue. Noted some tail latencies when batch_size >8 on A100 nodes. Recommend capping to 6 for now and monitor. I'll push a config change if you approve.

Leah (CS Manager): Agree to cap at 6. I'll schedule a 15m rundown with VelaRetail on Wed 10am PT. Need a short doc — Mia can you paste runbook here?

Mia (CS): Posting the mini runbook snippet:

```
1) Confirm client SDK pinned to v1.3
2) Enable prefix_cache: true
3) Set max_batch_size: 6
4) Enable telemetry: sampling=10%
```

Ryan (Infra): OpsBot shows last deploy: config-update at 1769840000, no errors.

OpsBot: config-update applied to vela-retail-prod (max_batch_size=6, ttl=45s)

Aisha (Finance): FYI cost calc: with current hit rate and batching we project -28% token spend MoM. Can we capture that in renewal deck? :) 

David (SE): I'll add a short note on risk: routes with long context windows still push p90 latency. Suggest we instrument a per-route batch histogram.

Mia (CS): Agreed. Action items:
- Ryan: enforce max_batch_size=6 + monitor p95/p99 (due: EOD today)
- David: add per-route batch histograms (due: Thu)
- Leah: enablement with customer Wed 10am PT (scheduled)
- Aisha: I'll send cost blurb for renewal deck (tomorrow)

Leah (CS Manager): Rubber stamp from me :thumbsup:

Mia (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with the runbook link and the short deck blurb.
